WhatsApp Business Platform

Connect useful conversations with a clear human handoff.

WBOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

WhatsApp Business Platform supports customer messaging, approved templates, and automated service journeys. MoreSpace can connect enquiry qualification, appointment updates, and customer follow-up with CRM records while keeping opt-in, service-window rules, and human escalation visible in the process.

Useful outputs

  • Structured enquiry records and assigned follow-up tasks
  • Template-based customer updates with delivery status
  • Conversation reporting and documented human escalation events

Where we can apply it

  • Inbound enquiry → qualification questions → CRM record → assigned salesperson.
  • Appointment status → eligible recipient check → approved template → reminder.
  • Customer question → reviewed knowledge response → unresolved issue → human handoff.
01

Use case 1

Qualify inbound enquiries and pass context to the sales team.

02

Use case 2

Send approved appointment or order-update templates to opted-in contacts.

03

Use case 3

Connect message events with CRM follow-up tasks and response reporting.

Inputs we need

  • Opt-in records and message-purpose definitions
  • Authorized business account and approved message templates
  • Qualification questions, CRM fields, and support escalation routes

Delivery sequence

  • Map conversation purposes, opt-in evidence, and escalation ownership.
  • Build templates and webhook handling, then test service-window behavior.
  • Connect qualified enquiries to CRM and monitor response quality.

Expert review points

  • Approve message templates and audience eligibility before sending.
  • Escalate uncertainty, sensitive requests, and unresolved conversations to people.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

Signals we can make visible

  • First response time
